values.name: Valuation based on price paid or payable without
values.description: Valuation based on price paid or payable without adjustments The valuation is to be based on the total payment made or to be made by the buyer to, or for the benefit of the seller for the imported goods, and includes all payments made as a condition of sale of the imported goods by the buyer to the seller, or by the buyer to a third party to satisfy an obligation of the seller.

values.name: Valuation based on price paid or payable with adjustments
values.description: Valuation based on price paid or payable with adjustments The valuation is to be based on the total payment made or to be made by the buyer to, or for the benefit of the seller for the imported goods, and includes all payments made as a condition of sale of the imported goods by the buyer to the seller, or by the buyer to a third party to satisfy an obligation of the seller but requiring applicable adjustments.

values.name: Valuation based on transaction value of identical goods
values.description: Valuation based on transaction value of identical goods Valuation is to be based on the transaction value of identical goods.

values.name: Valuation based on transaction value of similar goods
values.description: Valuation based on transaction value of similar goods The valuation is to be based on transaction value of similar goods that is goods closely resembling the goods being valued in terms of component materials and characteristics or goods which are capable of performing the same functions and are commercially interchangeable with the goods being valued or goods which are produced in the same country as and by the producer of the goods being valued.

values.name: Valuation based on deductive value of imported goods
values.description: Valuation based on deductive value of imported goods Valuation is to be based on the unit price at which the imported goods or identical or similar goods are sold to an unrelated buyer in the greatest aggregate quantity in the country of importation.

values.name: Valuation based on computed value
values.description: Valuation based on computed value The valuation is to be based on the cost of production of the goods being valued, plus an amount for profit and general expenses usually reflected in sales from the country of exportation to the country of importation of goods of the same class or kind.

values.name: Valuation based on the residual method
values.description: Valuation based on the residual method Valuation is to be based on reasonable means consistent with the principles and general provisions of the Agreement, Article VII GATT and on the basis of available data (fallback method).

values.name: Valuation adjustment for price influence
values.description: Valuation adjustment for price influence Valuation to be adjusted for price influence on account of relationship between buyer and seller.

values.name: Valuation adjustment for royalties
values.description: Valuation adjustment for royalties Valuation to be adjusted for royalties and licence fees related to the goods being valued that the buyer must pay, either directly or indirectly, as a condition of sale of the goods being valued, to the extent that such royalties and fees are not included in the price actually paid or payable.

values.name: Valuation adjustment for assists
values.description: Valuation adjustment for assists Valuation to be adjusted for goods and services, where supplied directly or indirectly by the buyer free of charge or at reduced cost for use in connection with the production and sale for export of imported goods, to the extent that such value has not been included in the price actually paid or payable. E.g. tools, dies, moulds, design work, engineering services.

values.name: Valuation adjustments for proceeds
values.description: Valuation adjustments for proceeds Value to be adjusted on the basis of value of any part of the proceeds of any subsequent resale, disposal or use of the imported goods that accrues, directly or indirectly, to the seller.

values.name: Valuation adjustments for commissions
values.description: Valuation adjustments for commissions Valuation to be adjusted for commissions and brokerage, except buying commissions as per Article 8 WTO Valuation Agreement.

values.name: Valuation adjustments for insurance
values.description: Valuation adjustments for insurance Valuation to be adjusted for insurance charges.

values.name: Valuation adjustment for freight charges
values.description: Valuation adjustment for freight charges Value to be adjusted for the cost of transport of the imported goods to the place of importation.

values.name: Valuation adjustment for handling charges
values.description: Valuation adjustment for handling charges Value to be adjusted for the costs of loading, unloading and handling charges associated with the delivery of the imported goods at the place of importation.

values.name: Valuation adjustments for allowances
values.description: Valuation adjustments for allowances Valuation to be adjusted for allowances.

values.name: Valuation adjustments for other buyer-incurred costs
values.description: Valuation adjustments for other buyer-incurred costs Valuation to be adjusted for other reasons to the extent they are incurred by the buyer but are not included in the price actually paid or payable for the imported goods, such as the cost of containers which are treated as being one for customs purposes with the goods in question, the cost of packing whether for labour or materials, materials, components, parts and similar items incorporated in the imported goods.

values.name: Mutually defined valuation adjustment
values.description: Mutually defined valuation adjustment Valuation adjustments as mutually agreed between the interchanging parties.
